_comment: Manual reference for all design tokens defined in src/index.css. Mirrors CSS custom properties. Update this file whenever index.css changes. Prepared for future Figma → Style Dictionary pipeline.
_changelog: v3.0 (2026-07-29): Fixed brand.primary stale blue → Kwickly Red oklch(0.551 0.203 26.6). Fixed ring, sidebar-primary, sidebar-accent, brand-tint stale values. Added platform-brand, motion, skeleton, kds token sections. Fixed radius base value 1.3rem → 0.5rem. Corrected chart-1 description.

background.description: App canvas. Use bg-background on root layout wrappers.

foreground.description: Default body text. Use text-foreground for all primary content.

card.description: Card surface. Slightly elevated over background. Use bg-card on all card/panel containers.

card-foreground.description: Text on card surface. Use text-card-foreground for card-level labels.

popover.description: Dropdown / modal overlay surface. Use bg-popover on shadcn Popover, DropdownMenu, Tooltip.

border.description: Default border. Applied globally via @layer base. Use border-border on dividers and card outlines.

ring.description: Focus ring. Defaults to Kwickly Red (matches --primary). Should track merchant brand color in AppShell.tsx v2 injection (see theme-system.md Section 11). Currently STATIC between brand switches — known gap.

muted.description: Subtle tinted surface for secondary areas, table headers, disabled states.

muted-foreground.description: Secondary / disabled / caption text. Use text-muted-foreground for hints, timestamps, metadata.

primary.description: Kwickly Red (rgb(238,59,43) / #EE3B2B). The primary action color — CTA buttons, active sidebar item, urgency indicators. Overridden at runtime by tenant brand color via AppShell.tsx.

primary-foreground.description: Text on primary surfaces. White against Kwickly Red by default. Computed by getContrastColor() at runtime when merchant overrides --primary.

secondary.description: Secondary interactive surface. Near-white in light, near-black in dark.

accent.description: Hover highlight background for ghost / nav items. Matches muted in light mode.

accent-foreground.description: Kwickly Blue text on accent (hover) surfaces. Uses chart-1 hue — intentionally NOT the primary red. STATIC: AppShell.tsx does not inject --accent-foreground. Does not follow merchant branding. Known gap — see theme-system.md Section 11.

platform-brand._comment: Static tokens for the Platform Portal (/platform/* routes only). NEVER overridden by merchant branding. Always Kwickly Blue (rgb(51,115,204)). Visually differentiates the system-operator context from the merchant context.

platform-primary.description: Kwickly Blue (rgb(51,115,204) / #3373CC approx). Platform portal brand identity color. Used in /platform/* headers and sidebar active states. Tailwind: bg-platform-primary.

platform-primary-foreground.description: White text on platform-primary blue surfaces. WCAG AA validated against oklch(0.612 0.123 282.5).

platform-primary-hover.description: Darkened Kwickly Blue for hover state on platform interactive elements. Approx rgb(40,92,168).

platform-primary-subtle.description: Low-opacity blue tint for platform badge backgrounds and selected-state highlights in the Platform Portal.

warning-foreground.description: Text on warning surface (dark for light-mode contrast on amber).

info.description: Informational / neutral highlight states. Sits near Kwickly Blue hue.

destructive.description: Errors, delete actions, unrecoverable danger states. Slightly deeper red than Kwickly Red (--primary).

motion._comment: Standardized animation durations and easing curves. All component transitions MUST use these variables. Never hardcode duration values or named easing strings like 'ease-in-out' directly in component className strings.

duration-fast.description: Micro-interactions: button press state, checkbox toggle, icon swap.

duration-normal.description: Standard UI transitions: hover background, border color, opacity fades. Default for most interactive elements.

duration-slow.description: Contextual panel transitions: sidebar collapse, tab switch, sheet panel open/close.

duration-slower.description: Page-level reveals: route transition fades, skeleton-to-content crossfade.

ease-standard.description: Material Design standard easing. Default for most element enter/exit transitions.

ease-spring.description: Springy overshoot. Use sparingly — badge pop-in, success checkmark scale.

ease-out.description: Decelerating easing. For elements entering the screen (drawer slide-in, toast appear).

skeleton._comment: Loading state tokens. All skeleton placeholder elements MUST use bg-skeleton and bg-skeleton-subtle instead of bg-muted/50 or ad-hoc opacity values.

skeleton.description: Primary skeleton block fill. Applied to all placeholder rectangles representing content areas, table rows, card bodies.

skeleton-subtle.description: Lighter shimmer highlight. Used as the bright phase in animate-pulse to simulate a scanning shimmer effect.

kds._comment: Kitchen Display System context-scoped tokens. Named by order lifecycle urgency state — NOT generic semantic color. Do NOT alias to --success/--warning/--destructive. KDS urgency is a distinct operational context requiring its own visual language.

kds-new.description: New/incoming order. Calm blue attention — not urgent. Uses Kwickly Blue hue. Tailwind: bg-kds-new, text-kds-new.

kds-cooking.description: Order in active preparation. Amber in-progress indicator. Same hue as --warning but distinct semantic context. Tailwind: bg-kds-cooking.

kds-late.description: Order overdue past target preparation time. Maximum urgency red — matches Kwickly Red (--primary). Tailwind: bg-kds-late.

kds-done.description: Order ready / completed. Success green — same hue as --success. Tailwind: bg-kds-done.

chart-1.description: Primary chart series. Uses Kwickly Blue hue (approx rgb(51,115,204)). NOTE: --primary is Kwickly Red; chart-1 is intentionally a distinct hue for data differentiation from the action color.

chart-4.description: Fourth chart series. Moved from green (hue 153) to magenta (hue 320) for CVD safety — was too close to chart-2.

sidebar.description: Sidebar background. Deep Navy (#0B1120) — fixed in both light and dark modes. The sidebar always appears dark regardless of page theme mode.

sidebar-primary.description: Active nav item highlight. Defaults to Kwickly Red. Overridden at runtime by AppShell.tsx to reflect the active tenant brand color.

sidebar-primary-foreground.description: Text on active sidebar nav item. Always white — validated against Deep Navy background.

sidebar-accent.description: Hover background for non-active nav items. Slightly lighter Deep Navy.

brand-runtime-fallbacks._comment: CSS aliases to --primary declared in :root and .dark. AppShell.tsx overrides these at runtime per active tenant. Components use var(--brand-primary) so they get a valid default (Kwickly Red) before the JS injection fires. NOTE: --ring and --accent-foreground are NOT in AppShell.tsx's injection list — they are static. See theme-system.md Section 11 for v2 migration path.
